facts.fact: 一位 fae 抱着重伤火貂冲进诊所。
facts.anchor: When a fae stumbled into my clinic with blood covering her clothes, cradling a fire ferret

facts.fact: Micah 在酒馆借蜂蜜酒消愁；酒保 Clarette 续杯。
facts.anchor: “You want another, Doc?” asks the bartender, Clarette.
“Was walking through town and saw you sitting here alone. Looked like you needed some company.”

facts.fact: 醉后 Micah 自责要辞职。
Lucan 劝其想想救活的病人。
facts.anchor: “You’re too hard on yourself,” Lucan insists, squeezing my shoulder.

facts.fact: Lucan 拿走酒杯（巨人酒量论）。
facts.anchor: He plucks the mug from my hand and pushes it across the bar

facts.fact: Micah 摔倒后，Lucan 以路远为由带他回铁匠铺楼上住所。
楼梯眩晕，Lucan 抱人上楼；让床睡沙发、递水递干净 tunic。
facts.anchor: He scoops me up easily into his arms.

facts.fact: Micah 穿着 Lucan 的旧上衣入睡。
